map036/ev008/p0.note: TM76 (Stealth Rock) item ball, inside the sealed 30-tile room (bbox x31-36 / y11-16). BFS over Map036's real walkability: 513 walkable tiles in 7 components, 450 reachable on foot from the entrance (17,39), and this room is in none of them -- wall on north/east/west, one southern opening into a surfable water pocket (terrain tag 7) that is itself disconnected. blocked, not unreachable: Surf is granted at Map143 (Act 5), a nameable future chapter, so a real revisit debt is owed. assertable=false because no walkable tile is adjacent -- the player cannot walk up and be refused, so no negative beat can be written now (contrast CH04's B6 rock, which had an open south face). The checker's own GraphApproachModel independently agreed: it raised no blocked_missed_assertion, which only happens when has_walkable_approach returns False. Doc B6, struck from the live list.
